      .                .         fn radix_by_ts<T: Copy + Default>(data: &mut Vec<T>, spare: &mut Vec<T>, low: u32, high: u32, ts: impl Fn(&T) -> u32) {
      .                .             let n = data.len();
      0              256 (0.0%)      if n < 2 || low >= high {
      .                .                 return;
      .                .             }
      .                .             const BITS: u32 = 11;
      .                .             const BUCKETS: usize = 1 << BITS;
      .                .             let span = high - low;
      .                .             let passes = (32 - span.leading_zeros()).div_ceil(BITS) as usize;
      .                .             let mut hist = vec![[0u32; BUCKETS]; passes];
      .                .             for item in data.iter() {
      0                0                 let v = ts(item) - low;
      .                .                 for (k, h) in hist.iter_mut().enumerate() {
      0                0                     unsafe { *h.get_unchecked_mut(((v >> (BITS * k as u32)) as usize) & (BUCKETS - 1)) += 1 };
      .                .                 }
      .                .             }
      .                .             spare.clear();
      .                .             spare.resize(n, T::default());
      .                .             for (k, h) in hist.iter_mut().enumerate() {
      0                0                 let shift = BITS * k as u32;
      0                0                 if h.iter().any(|&c| c as usize == n) {
      .                .                     continue;
      .                .                 }
      .                .                 let mut acc = 0u32;
      .                .                 for c in h.iter_mut() {
      .                .                     let v = *c;
      0                0                     *c = acc;
      0                0                     acc += v;
      .                .                 }
      .                .                 for item in data.iter() {
      0                0                     let d = (((ts(item) - low) >> shift) as usize) & (BUCKETS - 1);
      .                .                     unsafe {
      .                .                         let at = h.get_unchecked_mut(d);
      0                0                         *spare.get_unchecked_mut(*at as usize) = *item;
      0                0                         *at += 1;
      .                .                     }
      .                .                 }
      .                .                 std::mem::swap(data, spare);
      .                .             }
      .                .         }
